description: §13.2 (amended S478) — a loop whose body holds a suspension point counts as "after" the first `await` for its whole body: `event.preventDefault()` BEFORE the server call in the loop body still runs after the previous iteration's `await` from the second iteration on, so it is E-EVENT-CONTROL-AFTER-AWAIT.
provenance: ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S478 "⭐ RULED — open owner questions, PA recs adopted wholesale" item 11 (g-boot-event-control-in-suspending-loop-s478)
rationale: §13.2 amended S478: "A loop … whose body or condition contains a suspension point counts as after the first `await` for its WHOLE body and condition, in every iteration … any use of the event … inside such a loop, other than a plain read of a non-control property, is `E-EVENT-CONTROL-AFTER-AWAIT`." The conditional call (`i == 2`) would otherwise do nothing, silently.
